en.cardAutoPruneHint: Over the cap, creating a worktree removes the least recently used ones (folders only — branches are kept). Uncommitted changes or a running session are never removed.
en.cardDescription: Branch visibility and git worktree isolation for sessions; new worktrees are created inside their repository.
en.cardFetchBeforeCreateHint: Runs fetch --all --prune before each worktree creation. A failed sync never blocks the creation.
en.cardKeepWorktreesBad: Enter an integer of at least 1
en.cardKeepWorktreesHint: Global cap across all repositories, minimum 1.
en.cardManageHint: Browse and remove worktrees across repositories — including directories never registered as workspaces.
en.cardOpenGraphHint: Clicking the branch button in the composer opens the graph.
en.cardOpenGraphLabel: Open the commit graph by default
en.cardPostCreateCopyFilesHint: One relative path per line. Only used when .worktreeinclude is absent from repository root; if present, .worktreeinclude takes precedence.
en.cardReadOnly: The settings document is read-only; edits cannot be saved.
en.cardRootDirHint: Historical central location, kept only for the worktrees already living there. New worktrees are created at <repo>/.dsh/gitworktree/<branch> inside their repository and locally ignored through .git/info/exclude.
en.cardSaveFailed: The change did not save. Check the path is absolute and try again.
en.cardSwitchFailed: This switch did not save. Try again.

en.fetchFailRemoteUnreachable: Remote {remote} could not be reached: {url}. Check the network and the address.

en.pushFailAuth: Authentication failed. Check your Git credentials or SSH key; the plugin cannot prompt for a password.
en.pushFailBehind: The remote branch has commits you do not have locally. Update the branch first, or use Force push to overwrite them.
en.pushFailHook: A local pre-push hook refused this push. See the details below.
en.pushFailRefused: The remote refused the update (for example a protected branch or a server-side hook). See the details below.

en.pushTagsAllHint: Push all local Git tags, including tags unrelated to this branch

en.updateFailDiverged: The branch has diverged. Merge or rebase its upstream first.
en.updateFailNoUpstream: This branch has no upstream to update from. Push it and set an upstream first.
